evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking changes. Two new keys added to the top-level defaults.json with safe, non-disruptive defaults (auto_evict=false means the feature remains off by default). Existing user configs are unaffected. No schema, protocol, CLI contract, or persistence format changes. The PR author self-confirmed no breaking changes.
evidence.documentation: Documentation updated in docs/guide/configuration/README.md. Two new table rows added documenting auto_evict (bool, default false, describes VRAM pressure-based eviction) and auto_evict_threshold_pct (number, default 0.90, describes the VRAM fraction threshold). The documentation example block in the same file also includes the new keys. Changes are consistent with the defaults.json additions.
evidence.manual_release_testing: No user-facing behavior change beyond new default values for auto_evict (false) and auto_evict_threshold_pct (0.9) in the config. The auto_evict feature itself already exists in the codebase; this PR only fills in defaults that were previously missing from defaults.json. The CI validates the config schema through routing-schema and backend-doc-drift checks. The author's local smoke test (rename config.json, start server, confirm values visible) demonstrates the defaults land correctly. No additional manual testing is warranted for this release.
evidence.post_approval_commits: Zero commits were added after either approval. The single commit (71ae848) was pushed on 2026-09-02; @jeremyfowers approved the same commit 7 days later. No post-approval churn whatsoever.
evidence.review: PR #3488 was approved by @jeremyfowers (admin maintainer, review submitted 2026-09-09T14:42:29Z with 'Thanks for the fix!') and @superm1 (admin maintainer, review submitted 2026-09-09T19:39:22Z with an empty body). Both reviewers are in the maintainers table in contribute.md. No inline review comments were left. The PR is labeled rfc:not-required, consistent with the bug-fix nature. No review gaps identified.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change adds two configuration defaults — neither introduces code execution, credential handling, network calls, or permission changes. The values (false and 0.9) are conservative defaults.
evidence.tests: This PR changes only defaults.json (two new keys) and documentation. No source code logic was added, so no new unit tests are expected. The author manually verified the config values appear via `lemonade config` after removing their config.json. All CI checks passed on the merge-group run (workflow #34365414332): C++ unit tests, build on Linux amd64/arm64, Docker smoke test, routing schema tests, server download registry tests, docs-and-style checks, and packaging builds all succeeded.
